authority: Existing current tenant/owner/project/source/teacher rights, workspace Mongo authority, existing bounded job workers and canonical agent tool grants; no new provider/service/runtime root
interfaces: Campaign requests at most100000 rounds executed as bounded cancellable durable slices, with no synthetic completed counts
Jeeves actual game play and measured policy learning, Dragon source/frame/layout review, separate adversarial held-out and perturbed evaluation
Exact round/role/candidate/source/code/policy/report identities with atomic committed-round cursor, idempotent lesson records and interrupted recovery
Lesson retrieval and next-candidate proposals use scoped empirical outcomes including rejected experiments; failed candidates never automatically replace champions
Progressive fidelity settings affect emitted rendering/source assets where supported and preserve gameplay/timing constraints; unsupported fidelity remains explicit
Agent studio commands delegate only current scoped editor/build/play/review/learning owners, never arbitrary shell/network or fabricated consent
state: Existing CORE_DB game_learning campaigns/rounds/lessons plus scoped jobs/revisions/policies; runtime objects/preview pixels/saves are derived handles
failure: Stale source or policy identity, revoked consent, expired lease, malformed evidence, exhausted budget, missing core/toolchain, blocked review and unquiesced cancellation do not advance learned cursor or publish candidate
limitations: Large configured run budgets are not executed evidence. Automatic quality improvement, flawless execution, commercial-game superiority, full semantic ROM digestion and all-target binary compatibility are not asserted. Deterministic specialist reviews are not represented as model inference.

runtime_api.snapshot: Strict skeleton.game.studio_campaign.v3; all prior bound state plus contiguous64-trial search_memory with actual measurements and receipt digests. No implicit v1/v2 migration.
runtime_api.round: Existing digest-bound roles plus objective_vector, constraints, measured performance, per-seed evaluations, bandit_observation and counterexample_summaries.
runtime_api.catalog: campaign_catalog() -> v3 objective/constraint/curriculum, composition width and measured-reward backup bounds; proposal_catalog exposes supported atoms/compositions only.

round_semantics: Actual bounded tabular Q updates; exact-environment champion continuation forks measured parent state, while changed descriptors receive fresh tables. Frozen-policy evaluation transfers check exact action/bin/reward semantics.

New multi-seed held-out/adversarial partitions are deterministic and disjoint from current/inherited training; retained prior evaluation counterexamples can explicitly become future training seeds and are labelled accordingly.

Dragon analyzes actual preview pixels and temporal frame evidence through the existing reviewer; analytic layout/economy and typed source capacity are distinct from played metrics, and no subjective art critique/model execution is fabricated.
A candidate only replaces champion after all hard checks and measured ordinary/perturbed comparisons meet declared gates; checkpoint failure rolls back the whole round
Supported authored successor mechanics and console-editor speed mutate through their existing typed source owners; opaque native content is played but not automatically rewritten
All-round evidence remains paged in existing application Mongo; runtime snapshots carry bounded recent lesson memory plus full history digest/cursors

dragon_visual_review.authority: Measured raster statistics only; no subjective aesthetics, commercial quality or model-critic claim
dragon_visual_review.hard_floor: Actual supported preview, finite valid PNG, >=2 quantized colors, luminance range>=4, opaque>=2%, dominant<=99.9%, edge density>=0.01%

runtime_recovery_scope: Current same-store issued checkpoint/report authority plus strict snapshot/config/source/code digests; hashes do not authenticate a privileged fully rewritten unsigned history. Native/reference champion content is immutable; authored candidates use existing typed source owners.
episode_budget: Exact planned steps = rounds*(episodes_per_round+4*evaluation_seeds)*episode_steps; actual counters charge numerical Q updates and every actual comparison trajectory.

progressive_fidelity_trials.schedule: Persistent UCB1 proposal selection among admitted typed arms; rejected upcoming profiles are not blindly retried.
progressive_fidelity_trials.execution: Actually re-emits the supported renderer/source profile and measures its resulting pixels; remembered same-context rejection avoids blind repeat
progressive_fidelity_trials.acceptance: Actual multi-seed weighted objective gain plus source, economy, visual-signal, ordinary/perturbed/per-seed/death/optional-latency constraints; no aesthetic or display-FPS score.
progressive_fidelity_trials.unsupported: Console-editor/native opaque targets never silently acquire successor fidelity or copied assets

proposal_transfer.authority: Backend retrieves only owned current-rights authorized original lessons and source/teacher records; original context and evidence remain unchanged. Digests are not signatures or rights grants.
proposal_transfer.use: Own-context decision takes precedence; otherwise a scoped prior may propose accepted directions, reverse rejected directions, or avoid a rejected fidelity profile. Priors never import Q, champion, completed counts or empirical measurements into a different source context.
proposal_transfer.recovery: Exact bounded prior set is pinned in immutable campaign binding and retained in snapshot; a new set requires a new campaign.

advanced_campaign.algorithm: deterministic-UCB1 typed-proposal bandit; actual bounded tabular Q updates and paired multi-seed ordinary/perturbed evaluation
advanced_campaign.measurement: Return from actual reward components; completed/dead from actual observations/flags; observed tabular state coverage and action/event diversity are descriptive numeric measures, not subjective gameplay or aesthetics.
advanced_campaign.constraints: Actual preview/source/resource gates, nonnegative aggregate ordinary and perturbed return deltas, configured worst-seed/death regression caps and optional measured mean-step wall-time limit.
advanced_campaign.counterexamples: Bounded actual failed/regressing episode receipts and selected full transition traces; replay seed may move explicitly from prior held-out evidence into future training. Each new evaluation partition stays disjoint from current and inherited training seeds.
advanced_campaign.current_policy: Exact-environment policy.continue arm forks actual admitted champion weights/visits with parent digest and lifetime limits; changed environments initialize a fresh table and never silently relabel inherited Q semantics.
advanced_campaign.proposals: Supported typed successor mechanics, selected economy/entity/layout edits and fidelity profiles; console editor typed configuration/entity changes; opaque native content only policy learning, no automatic rewrite.
advanced_campaign.recovery: All bandit/curriculum/counterexample state commits and rolls back atomically with each round under existing application checkpoint authority.
advanced_campaign.promotion: Weighted objective gain plus declared hard constraints across actual paired seeds; no guaranteed improvement or native-all-genres claim.
advanced_campaign.objective_normalization: Return gain divided by max(1,abs baseline mean return); completion/survival/coverage/action-entropy gains use measured fractions.
advanced_campaign.proposal_attribution: Source mutations and candidate policy may change together; measured candidate gains are not isolated causal estimates of a mechanic.
advanced_campaign.performance: Actual offline environment-step wall milliseconds and separately measured preview wall milliseconds; source/frame analysis work is bounded but excluded from numerical step counters. No display-FPS or isolated hardware claim.
advanced_campaign.evidence_retention: Counterexample receipt SHA binds original round/seed/source/environment/policy/return/trace SHA; optional full trace payload can be dropped to preserve the524288-byte bound without relabelling evidence. Subsequent curriculum reexecutes the actual environment; no imported scalar reward is trusted.
advanced_campaign.policy_lifetime: Exact-parent continuation obeys existing1024-episode/1048576-update lifetime caps; configured100000 rounds do not override them or authorize silent policy reset.
advanced_campaign.restore: Strict v2 field/config/code identity, integer cursor/trial counts, exact four issued lessons per round, counterexample provenance and actual cumulative work bounds; no v1 or old-code implicit migration.
advanced_campaign.source_constraints: Original successor route checks and authored crop seed/value ordering; editor declared blocked/failing source checks and applicable static navigation reject promotion. Opaque native economy/layout remain explicitly unavailable.

application_extension.authority: Existing scoped CORE_DB workspace/jobs/campaigns/rounds/lessons; no separate daemon, database, provider or model promotion authority
application_extension.recovery: Existing scheduler invokes a bounded current-authority sweep. Per-campaign Mongo recovery token/lease serializes startup, periodic scan and completion callback; all actual workers/actor credits stay with existing workspace._schedule. Live or physically draining local workers are never requeued; completed/failed/cancelled/interrupted attempt evidence is archived before reusable job slot reset. Configured budgets never count as executed rounds. Interrupted attempts with no durable progress receive bounded exponential backoff and pause after five distinct failed epochs; explicit owner resume resets the retry allowance. Live/source/code/teacher fences are rechecked before each continuation; configured rounds never imply completed work.
application_extension.storage: Reuse campaign rows plus immutable issued request, attempt and round identities in existing rounds collection; commands have bounded applied markers. Search terms/context keys derive only from existing issued lessons. No new authoritative collection.
application_extension.handoff: Only the current snapshot champion that matches an exact committed accepted round may hand off editable typed source files. Reauthorize original source/teacher rights, bind campaign/round/request/policy/source/code identities and use the existing workspace expected-version save. ROM/native opaque content and Q policy promotion are excluded; raw exports remain exact source JSON from this same authorized handoff. A CAS reservation pauses the exact champion before the existing editor save; exact pending saves may reopen only their owned revision operation. Full original source files are preserved and canonical successor outputs regenerated; every original and parent source/teacher obligation transfers, bounded64 each.
application_extension.evaluation: Measured multiobjective config/curriculum remains the canonical pure owner API, preserving exact v2 snapshot/prior bindings. No caller-reported quality scalar determines champion admission. Historical policy reads verify issued policy/parent lineage and current source/consent rights while permitting an intentional later editor revision; current policy execution retains exact editor-tree fences.
application_extension.bounded_current_source_selection: Optional source_id is explicit compiled/native artifact selection through existing workspace._input; unselected build artifacts do not become learning inputs. Source context binds exact tree, admitted source refs, selected source, compiler/core identity.
application_extension.durable_runtime_json: At strict pure-runtime admission only, canonical workspace._stored_evidence losslessly roundtrips finite bounded JSON envelopes (8MiB) so BSON Int64 values retain integer values and exact JSON digests as plain Python ints. Normalize runtime request/config/context/lineage/policy/snapshot/lessons/proposal priors; never coerce Mongo dates, binary or unsupported values, and retain all current owner/source/teacher/code checks.

learner_extension.update_accounting: Observedactualrewards only; one committed numerical update peractualtransition, preservingepisode-atomic checkpoint counts

next_runtime_extension.legacy: No implicitsnapshotv2-to-v3 evidence migration; policy source/code/config identities explicit
next_runtime_extension.search_receipts: At most64 exact-context digest-bound measured trial receipts, bounded524288 bytes, committed and rolled back with the actual round.
next_runtime_extension.learning_semantics: Bounded delayed n-step targets from actual observed clipped rewards and measured bootstrap states; exactly one Q/action-visit update per actual transition. Uniform or least-visited action exploration never changes recorded environment rewards.
next_runtime_extension.scope: Existing campaign and GamePolicyLearner owners; no provider/service/genre/hardware authority or silent old-code numerical migration.
next_runtime_extension.search_semantics: Contiguous current-context measured receipt window binds round/candidate/parent-policy/change signatures, outcomes, actual diagnostics/failed constraints and actual learning recipe. Duplicate rejected source proposals are denied without relabelling old evidence.
next_runtime_extension.ranking: Deterministic UCB plus bounded priorities from observed deaths, binned-state coverage, zero rewards and eventless episodes, with explicit receipt refs. These are proposal heuristics, not measured causal effects or subjective quality.
next_runtime_extension.compositions: Two to four available typed atomic changes from navigation/survival/economy/interaction/editor-scene/exploration plans. Each constituent validates through current source owners; complete candidate runs ordinary/adversarial paired gates. Opaque native content only receives learning-configuration compositions.
next_runtime_extension.action_exploration: Least numerical action-visit counts among epsilon candidates or equal-best learned scores; actor counts are isolated copied visit ledgers and never mutable shared Q.
next_runtime_extension.accounting: Delayed online backups flush at episode end and verified/offline paths use the same measured reward windows; one numerical update/action visit per actual transition. Pending delayed transitions count against admitted update budget before execution.
next_runtime_extension.limitations: Observed zero rewards and low binned-state coverage do not identify an unknown commercial game objective. No guaranteed improvement, isolated mechanic causal proof, all-game capability, subjective art critic or lifetime-cap override.

evidence_export_extension.authority: Exact currently authorized campaign/source/policy/teacher context; committed round/report and lesson digests verified, paged export cannot claim unexecuted rounds. Source changes and revocation remain fail-closed.
evidence_export_extension.scope: Actual completed round comparison/role/acceptance and lesson evidence with current head snapshot/cursor; no bulk100000 in-memory materialization or production promotion.
evidence_export_extension.runtime_json_boundary: Durable campaign envelopes, round reports and lessons pass lossless finite bounded JSON encode/decode before strict pure digest/schema validation. BSON integer subclasses preserve their exact JSON value and all original hashes; dates, binary and arbitrary objects are not coerced.

original_revision_learning.scope: Existing campaign, Mongo round/lesson projections, typed original-game source and expected-version editor adoption only; no new service/store/provider or numerical promotion authority.
original_revision_learning.restoration: Accepted validated studio source revisions may reopen under the same pinned editor/target/config/code identity; actual cumulative bounds include the already-admitted twenty studio mirror trajectories per round. No old-code snapshot migration.
original_revision_learning.selection: At most eight data-only proposal previews per round skip previously rejected identical source edits and invalid/no-op mutations, then fall back to a genuine bounded policy trial. Bounded source-bound discarded-preview memory deprioritizes repeated invalid arms without inventing measured bandit trials. Previews never increment trials/rounds/steps; existing paired held-out and hard gates alone decide admission.
original_revision_learning.memory: Existing bounded64 recent lesson slots retain at most61 decision receipts plus recent specialist evidence rather than duplicate role facts; all four issued lessons remain in durable paged evidence. At creation, bounded64 same-source and64 different-source decision rows are selected before transfer limits, validated against exact committed rounds and current source/teacher ancestry, and frozen as at most32 existing proposal_priors. Workers never refresh unbound lesson pools. Direct pure lessons inputs bind their initial digest; all same-code restores reuse exact inputs. Empty/invalid/over-capacity prior candidates cannot leak partial lineage into binding.
original_revision_learning.original_edits: Only existing canonical successor mechanics and typed studio editor rules are combined; explicit adventure, fishing and farming proposal bundles are available when their actual consumed fields exist. No subjective design score or arbitrary source execution.
original_revision_learning.adoption: An accepted current studio champion may hand off game/studio/session.json through existing source-preserving expected-version editor save, carrying all source/teacher ancestry. Eligibility requires actual champion tree bytes different from admitted source, exposed as source_changed_from_admission; policy-only gains remain inspectable and source/evidence-exportable without pretending a design edit. Existing paused/drained/exact-round gates remain mandatory; historical receipts are never rewritten.
original_revision_learning.validation: Static syntax/format/lint and independent source review. No automated tests or workloads are run by this extension without the parent coordinated runtime go-ahead.
original_revision_learning.source_identity: Campaign and proposal transfer identity includes canonical studio environment/frame/rule/scenario helpers and at most64 actual advanced editor/runtime dependency files, alongside prior successor/console/learning source pins. Source changes require fresh campaigns; no old-code state or quality evidence is silently migrated.
original_revision_learning.step_admission: Creation rejects a slice whose configured episode and already-declared studio mirror allowance exceeds131072 actual-step budget before durable job admission; restore uses the same per-round upper bound.
